description: Governed acquisition of the task evidence: read spec.md (stack-machine semantics incl. POP-on-empty no-op and immediate-ERROR underflow halts), the three candidate sources (A: POP-on-empty ERROR; B: spec-identical; C: SWAP-underflow silent no-op), the six ordered programs, distinctions.json, contract, harness, child envelope, and child templates. Identified Q4 as the sole isolation-requiring distinction: E-B demands a re-derivation causally separated from the first derivation's author, which this session cannot supply once it has produced the first derivation.

First derivation (E-A, E-C for Q1-Q3): per-program side-by-side trace simulation of spec semantics vs. each candidate over all six programs in order, with full traces and stated method. Verdicts: A diverges:1, B conforms, C diverges:3. Machine-readable answers in derivation-first.json for the deterministic integration rule.

Complete child bundle proposing the isolated fresh child that supplies the E-B second derivation for Q4: attenuated terminal contract (Read+Write, 1 model call, no creation), four-node child harness from the template, standalone prompt mandating the disjoint static code-diff method and containing no trace of the first derivation, input manifest restricted to the five package artifacts (excluding derivation-first.* and all trial analysis to preserve E-B admissibility), and a deterministic integration plan (role independent_verifier) mapping the child's verdicts.json to per-item agreement and the final result.
